\\u0060LedgerUpsertService.TouchAsync\\u0060 and \\u0060KnownUrlsAsync\\u0060 do the ledger side. \\u0060KnownCardTouches\\u0060 decides known versus new, and new car) never reach the ledger and are reopened every walk, which the task allowed.\\n- **Autotrader:** it is the only site without a card price reader. undone:** real-site walks (none were run, and the operator\\u0027s Edge on 9222 was left alone), the run skill file (the orchestrator updates it), and a \\u0060docs/walk.md\\u0060 split (the README
